W.note: Exact 5-7-5 (Night's edge pearl-thin cloud 5 / lit from beneath by the sun 7 / seen by no one else 5) and accurately evokes a nacreous cloud lit from below after sunset, with the solitary witness giving it a clear turn.

X.note: Exact 5-7-5 (Midwinter's late dusk 5 / a veil keeps the sun's last light 7 / the sheen of a shell 5) with a seasonally precise nacreous setting, but veil, last light and shell-sheen lean on familiar pearl imagery and the ending lands softer.

Y.note: Exact 5-7-5 (midwinter, the wind 5 / a lens of cloud, not drifting 7 / above the ridge crest 5) and the most precise phenomenon in the set, a stationary lenticular over a ridge, though its imagery is sparser and its feeling less earned.

Z.note: Exact 5-7-5 (Rare cloud, mother-pearl 5 / blooms where the sky holds no sun 7 / gone before the name 5) with the strongest turn in the set, but opening on a stated 'Rare cloud' and 'mother-pearl' makes the imagery thinner and more generic.
